Overview

Graz is a city in Styria with a population of 302,749. Austria’s second-largest city, a UNESCO City of Design with a beautifully preserved medieval old town, a thriving culinary scene, and a dynamic student population. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
